rows.jyutping: seng4 go3 gung1 zok3 kwong4 gam3
rows.note: This is the all-purpose colloquial way to describe someone or something as having a workaholic-like manner.

example.english: They’re still answering emails after work, acting like a workaholic.
example.traditional: 佢放工都仲覆緊電郵，成個工作狂咁。
example.jyutping: keoi5 fong3 gung1 dou1 zung6 fuk1 gan2 din6 jau4 seng4 go3 gung1 zok3 kwong4 gam3
